title: Tenant isolation signoff orchestrator for dedicated capacity
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an orchestration service that assembles, verifies, and signs a tenant isolation signoff bundle for Dedicated capacity customers. The bundle is intended to provide a single artifact suitable for auditors and customer security teams: it should include tenant placement topology, node residency assertions, network ACL snapshot, retention policy pointers, KMS key references, relevant audit log excerpts, and a signed manifest showing verification steps. The service must support on-demand generation and periodic snapshots, integrate with the existing evidence retention pipeline, and provide a short-lived pre-signed URL for customers and auditors to download the bundle. It should avoid duplicating heavy telemetry by referencing existing exports (S3 path / ledger ids) where possible.
acceptance_criteria: Service can generate a complete signoff bundle for a tenant in under 10 minutes for up to 100 nodes

Bundle contains (a) placement map, (b) retention settings for tenant's storage, (c) KMS key identifiers used, (d) hashed audit log excerpts and links to full export, (e) signed manifest with verifier signature
Generated artifact is signed by Redwood KMS-backed key and signature verification doc is published
Pre-signed download link expires and is auditable via dashboard; download events are logged
E2E tests and a small synthetic audit run exist in CI that validate bundle completeness
Documented runbook for on-call to troubleshoot failures and a fallback that returns partial evidence with clear caveats
rollout_plan: Build MVP that emits unsigned bundles and stores in staging S3 for manual review (week 1-2)
Add signature step using Redwood KMS and record signature metadata in evidence ledger (week 3)
Wire pre-signed URL generation and access controls; add download telemetry to Console (week 4)
Canary with two internal dedicated tenants, then pilot with 1 customer (week 5)
Full rollout gated by security review and compliance signoff (week 6)
comments: 2026-03-10 Aisha Patel: Created ticket after sync with Compliance and PM. PM requested a single artifact auditors can consume rather than multiple disconnected exports.
